newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker stymied on wide cash/paper spread.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker stymied on wide cash/paper spread.

text.p: Singapore bunker trade was stymied on Thursday afternoon as sellers either withheld offers or indicated very high levels, traders said.
"It's very confused," said one trader. "There is a wide disparity between paper and cash .. around $7."
On Wednesday, cash trade was reported at $93 per tonne while February paper was last quoted at $101.50/$102.50.

The few sellers that were indicating, quoted closer to paper levels with 180-cst at $107-$110 per tonne and 380-cst at 101-5-$104. Shipowners were desperately looking for sellers but there has not been much confirmation, traders said.
